description:
FILED s458ak from the #841 probe battery (probed 5.40.3, both blessed and UNBLESSED, so it is NOT the #841 class guard).  REPRO: sub w { $_[0] .= "!" } my $h = {k=>"v"}; w($h->{k}); print $h->{k};  -- perl prints v!, PCL prints v.  Array twin: my $a=["a"]; w($a->[0]) -- perl a!, PCL a.  The NAMED spellings w($n{k}) and w($na[0]) are CORRECT today (they lower to p-gethash-argbox / p-aref-argbox), and so is the SLICE-through-a-ref spelling w(@$h{"k"}) since #841.  CAUSE (read from the emission): a deref element in argument position lowers to (p-gethash-deref $h "k") / (p-aref-deref $a 0), which return VALUES; the argbox/cell family is never reached.  FIX SHAPE: the arrow/deref element needs the same argument-position lowering the named element has -- one argbox-shaped deref accessor routed through %p-hash-elem-cell / %p-elem-cell like every other alias site, selected by the SAME emission rule that already picks p-gethash-argbox for $n{k}.  SILENT WRONG (the program continues with a value perl would never produce).  BAR: the p841/p841b probe pair vs perl (8+7 rows), elem-alias-01.t gains the deref spellings under both PCL_RAW_ELEMS settings, corpus-diff + full sweep (emission change).

NOT A NEW CLASS: this is the residue `docs/not-supported.md` SS`@_` argument aliasing already listed as "deref elements (f($ref->{k})) ... extendable via the same argbox accessors if real code needs them", and `docs/ir-spec.md` SS5 repeats.  What s458ak adds is the PROBE (it is a silent wrong, not a documented copy-by-design) and the confirmation that the array twin f($ref->[0]) has it too, on plain AND blessed refs alike.  The not-supported.md entry now carries the repro and points here.
subject: f($ref->{k}) / f($ref->[0]) is NOT an @_ alias -- an element reached through a REFERENCE deref hands the callee a detached copy (perl aliases; the NAMED spellings already do)
